## 🎨 Design System

### Color Palette (OSCAR Fashion Theme)
```
Primary:   #2C3E50 (Elegant Dark Blue)
Secondary: #E8D5C4 (Sophisticated Beige)
Accent:    #C9A992 (Warm Brown)
Success:   #10b981 (Green)
Warning:   #f59e0b (Orange)
Error:     #ef4444 (Red)
Info:      #3b82f6 (Blue)
```

### Typography
- Font Family: Inter (Google Font)
- Arabic Font: Noto Sans Arabic (for RTL)
- Sizes: 2xs to 6xl with line heights

### Components Design
- Rounded corners (0.5rem radius)
- Subtle shadows for elevation
- Smooth transitions (300ms)
- Hover states on interactive elements
- Focus rings for accessibility

### Available Commands

npm run build         # Production build
npm run start         # Production server
npm run codegen       # Generate GraphQL types
npm run format        # Format with Prettier

## 🔧 Technical Decisions

### Why Next.js 14 App Router?
- Modern React patterns (Server Components)
- Built-in routing with layouts
- Automatic code splitting
- SSR/SSG out of the box
- Image optimization
- Font optimization

### Why Apollo Client?
- Powerful GraphQL client
- Built-in caching
- SSR support for Next.js
- Type-safe with codegen
- DevTools available

### Why Tailwind CSS?
- Utility-first approach
- Highly customizable
- Small bundle size
- Great DX with IntelliSense
- Responsive design made easy

### Why Formik + Yup?
- Best practices for React forms
- Schema-based validation
- TypeScript support
- Easy error handling
- Good documentation
